name: ecommerce-fulfillment-filament
description: Optional Filament administration for the Fulfillment domain module: what an order still owes, the parcels raised against it, and the state machine's own legal moves. Read-only everywhere else, and there is no editable counter anywhere.
features: What an order still owes, as a pick list
Parcels, with a destination and a carriage cost of their own
The shipment state machine as actions
Nothing that could lower a dispatched count
Cancellation refused once a parcel has left
Over-shipping surfaced as a refusal, never clamped
Cancellation reasons from a fixed vocabulary
Tracking kept out of search, filters and logs
